meta.title: My orders
meta.description: Look up an order you placed at Ihmom Store using the phone number and order number from your confirmation.

lookup.title: Find your order
lookup.description: Enter the phone number and order number from your order confirmation. We only show the order that matches both.
lookup.phoneHint: Use a Palestinian mobile number, for example 059 123 4567.
lookup.phoneError: Enter a valid Palestinian mobile number.
lookup.orderNumberHint: Find it on your order confirmation. The leading # is optional.
lookup.orderNumberError: Enter the order number from your confirmation.

history.title: Order details
history.invoiceErrorDescription: Please try again or look up the order again.
history.idleDescription: Enter the phone number and order number from your confirmation to see the order.
history.emptyDescription: We couldn't find an order matching those details. Check them and try again.
history.invalidDescription: Check the phone number and order number and try again. For your security, we don't confirm which detail is incorrect.
history.rateLimitedDescription: Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
history.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.

meta.title: Your cart
meta.description: Review your items before checking out.

cart.emptyDescription: Browse the catalogue and add the products you love.
cart.deliveryNote: The delivery fee is calculated at checkout.
cart.clearDescription: All items will be removed from your cart.
cart.itemsDescription: Change quantities or remove items before checking out.

meta.title: Checkout
meta.description: Enter your delivery details to place the order. No account is needed.

review.title: Review & confirm
review.description: Check the details and place the order

checkout.reviewDescription: Check the details below. You can edit anything before placing the order.
checkout.reviewNote: We will call you on the phone number above to confirm the order. Payment is collected in cash on delivery.
checkout.name: Full name
checkout.phoneHint: Use a Palestinian mobile number, for example 059 123 4567.
checkout.areasError: Delivery areas could not be loaded.
checkout.addressPlaceholder: Street, building, floor, and any landmarks
checkout.notesPlaceholder: Anything we should know about this delivery
checkout.errorTitle: We could not place your order
checkout.errorDescription: Check your details and try again.
checkout.emptyDescription: Add products to your cart before checking out.
checkout.successDescription: Your order {{number}} has been placed successfully. Please save your order number or download your invoice. You will need both the order number and the phone number you provided to look up and track your order later.
checkout.invoiceDownloadedNotice: Invoice downloaded. Keep the file somewhere safe.
checkout.invoiceNote: Important: Download and save your invoice now, or keep your order number somewhere safe. You will need your order number and the phone number used at checkout to find and track your order later. Without these details, you won't be able to look up your order yourself.
checkout.invoiceErrorDescription: Please try again or look up the order from My orders.
checkout.invoiceWarningDescription: You have not downloaded the invoice for order {{number}}. Without it, you will need both your order number and the phone number used at checkout to find your order later. Leaving without it could make tracking your order difficult. Are you sure you want to leave?
checkout.cashNote: Payment is collected in cash on delivery.
checkout.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Palestinian mobile number
